claim: From the previously exact SHA-pinned 440 named original fpw_* resource source bodies, cumulative block boundaries at embedded +48..+63 partition 24384 12-byte source blocks into 1347 nonempty raw segments. Each segment's first 12-byte block is followed by exactly the unsigned segment leading byte number of additional 12-byte blocks. Across the complete 440-source GGM-indexed panel this yields 23037 source-form blocks (276444 original bytes), with 15571 distinct 12-byte source patterns and 7214 distinct unsigned big-endian two-byte values at form-block-relative offsets +2..+3 (minimum100 maximum37998). The entire concatenated original form-block byte sequence SHA256 is 93807a1a2d1208e693ef225d80598f3d1fb70f58d2a132d63fd052c97668ba18; complete 440-source index rows SHA256 74e5ed2b12e07ba33463f7ec11e743889ce5e91afe967094b8940751cdbb79c9; indexed 23037 per-form provenance rows SHA256 23b2891ea046ae01b8187044c19a86da9efbc0e24e9ec33ec25a4e3ac36f0f91. Matching prior independently SHA-verified original retail DLL SkillDataMan.ParseRSFData source IL proves exactly twelve advancing input bytes per nested FormDispInfo entry, in byte order: two signed centerPos bytes; two unsigned big-endian formIdx bytes; two signed formOfsPos bytes (multiplied by 2.0f); one unsigned dispFrm byte; priority byte; initial flags byte; additional flags/direction byte; two sound/control bytes. This is exact source layout and independently proven DLL read-order alignment, not evidence the 440 resources were loaded and parsed in retail execution, or that these byte blocks signify displayed animation frame durations, pixels or sprite transformations.
